# NFL PLAYERS

NFL Player Disability & Neurocognitive Benefit Plan

Total and Permanent Disability Benefits Application

Signature and Authorization

I certify that all information and documents provided on or with this Total and Permanent Disability Benefits Application are, to the best of my knowledge, true, correct, and complete. I also authorize the NFL Player Disability & Neurocognative Benefit Plan to use or disclose all individually identifiable health information submitted to the Plan on my behalf, or created in connection with my Application, to all individuals as needed for Plan purposes.

I understand that I may be required to undergo a comprehensive evaluation, and I certify that I will be able to attend such evaluation within 30 days from the date this Application is received by the Plan Office. I understand that failure to attend without 2 business days advance notice, and cooperate with such evaluation will result in my Application being denied.
